questions.q: Where are quotes, orders, invoices and credit notes created and stored?
o: In the CRM, on the Opportunity
In Intact — the CRM has no order object at all
In both, kept in sync automatically
questions.e: Intact is the system of record for money and documents. The CRM holds the relationship and the control layer. There is no order object in the CRM and you should not try to build one.

questions.q: Who decides the price on a standard quotation?
o: Customer Operations, within the agreed rules
The salesperson — Operations builds and sends the rest
questions.e: Operations prepares the quotation in Intact and sends it from sales@; the salesperson decides the price only. If it is the same price as last time, Operations checks Intact and sends.

questions.q: What joins a CRM company to its Intact account?
o: The Account code — the Intact A/C code stored on the company
questions.e: Account code is the join key. Names and domains drift and duplicate; the A/C code does not.

questions.q: The rule of thumb for who owns what?
o: Whoever opened the email owns everything
If it is about winning the money it is sales; if it is about delivering on the promise it is Customer Operations
Sales owns the customer, Ops owns the system
Ops owns everything until the order is placed
questions.e: Sales keeps the relationship, the pricing and every commercial decision. Ops owns the quoting admin, order processing, supplier and courier chasing, and keeping the customer informed. When in doubt it goes through sales@ and gets an owner either way.
